hints.title: Remainder Congruence Subarray Count
hints.text: Subarrays whose sums are divisible by k share equal prefix sum remainders modulo k. How can counting previous remainder frequencies enumerate all valid subarrays?

hints.title: Modulo Pair Contribution Invariant
hints.text: Each time remainder r appears, it pairs with all previous instances of remainder r to form a divisible contiguous subarray.

hints.title: Modulo Frequency Accumulation Procedure
hints.text: Initialize a remainder frequency counter with remainder 0 having count 1. For each number, update running prefix modulo k (handling negative values cleanly), add the existing frequency of that remainder to total count, and increment its frequency.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input element count or target integer bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(K) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating every pair of indices (i, j) takes O(N^2) time, which is too slow for N = 30,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting k distinct remainder frequencies runs in O(N) time with O(k) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should properly normalize negative modulo results in languages like C++ and Java where % can yield negative remainders.
